name: factorialAcc_correct
prelude:
def factorial : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => (n + 1) * factorial n
def factorialAcc : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, a => a
  | n + 1, a => factorialAcc n (a * (n + 1))
statement: theorem factorialAcc_correct (n : Nat) : factorialAcc n 1 = factorial n
proofs:
have invariant (k a : Nat) : factorialAcc k a = a * factorial k := by
    induction k generalizing a with
    | zero => simp [factorialAcc, factorial]
    | succ k ih => simp [factorialAcc, factorial, ih, Nat.mul_assoc]
  simpa using invariant n 1
  have scale (k a b : Nat) : factorialAcc k (a * b) = a * factorialAcc k b := by
    induction k generalizing b with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => simpa [factorialAcc, Nat.mul_assoc] using ih (b * (k + 1))
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := scale n (n + 1) 1
    simpa [factorialAcc, factorial, ih] using h
strategies: Prove the general multiplicative accumulator invariant.
Prove scaling equivariance, then induct at accumulator one.
